name: alex-git
description: Operating knowledge for Alex's git estate. One skill: alex-repos — the map of every working copy (path, remote, branch model, and what a push deploys), the two GitHub identities and the exact limits of each token, and the traps that have already cost hours: misleading 'Repository not found', stale fetch caches, work hiding in a second clone, the two-way Shopify theme integration, and two sessions sharing one working tree.
